'''Chapter 1041''' is titled "Komurasaki".

==Cover Page==
[[Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion]], Vol. 5: This is for bullying Sanji-san! Pudding Punch!

[[Charlotte Pudding|Pudding]] punches [[Vinsmoke Niji|Niji]] and [[Vinsmoke Yonji|Yonji]].

==Short Summary==
"Komurasaki" reveals to Orochi that she is [[Kouzuki Hiyori]] as she buries him with a ceiling cave-in and renders him unable to use his [[Devil Fruit]] transformation. Elsewhere, [[Izou]] manages to defeat the [[CP0]] agent [[Maha]] but goes down in the process, and the remaining agent receives a call relaying an edict from the [[Five Elders]] to eliminate [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] immediately, without regard to his current status battling [[Kaidou]]. Meanwhile, [[Raizo]] has emerged victorious over [[Fukurokuju]] and [[Franky]] recovers the unconscious [[Zoro]], while those on the Live Floor react to [[Kid]] and [[Law]]'s triumph over [[Big Mom]]. Kid and Law are left in no state to fight Kaidou, and Luffy is determined to take down the Emperor before his final usage of [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques|Gear 4]] runs out.

==Long Summary==
[[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] tells [[Yamato]] that he spoke with [[Zunesha]] briefly and learned that the giant elephant has come to aid him in the battle. Yamato reacts with amazement and tells Momonosuke that he must be the one who will lead the world to its [[Dawn of the World|dawn]] like his [[Kouzuki Oden|father]] predicted, but while Momonosuke acknowledges he cannot die in this fight, he reveals that Oden tore out the most crucial pages of his journey, specifically what he and [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] found on [[Laugh Tale]] so long ago. Momonosuke then tells Yamato that he does not consider himself as wise as his father, and when he thinks about all the potential dangers of the outside world, it makes him want to keep [[Wano Country|Wano's]] borders shut rather than open them like he wanted, prompting him to ask Yamato if he thinks him a coward for thinking that.

On the third floor of the castle's interior, [[Fukurokuju]] has fallen unconscious from the flames, releasing [[Raizo]] from his binding technique and declaring him the victor. Once freed, Raizo starts rolling around in an attempt to put out the fire just as [[Jinbe]] comes across him. Raizo tells Jinbe that the two of them must move quickly for the "preparations" are almost complete. In the Treasury on the second floor, [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] starts growing impatient with Fukurokuju, with not even "Komurasaki"'s music being able to calm him down. He starts demanding she take off her mask so he can see if she is real or a ghost, but some of the ceiling crashes down on him. While trapped under the debris, Orochi realizes he cannot transform, with "Komurasaki" revealing it was because she stuck a [[Seastone]] nail in him while she was playing. Orochi is outraged by her action as he asks her if she loved him, but she coldly replies that she bears no love towards him. She then tells him that it is poetic that his favorite song is "[[Moon Princess]]" which was her father's favorite too. It is then that [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Hiyori]] reveals her true identity to a horrified Orochi, and that she wore the mask so she could avoid smiling for him while playing it.

In the castle basement, [[Izou]] has taken down one of the [[CP0]] agents, named [[Maha]], though he goes down as well. The other agent, [[Guernika]], is injured but still conscious and curses Izou for taking down one of them with him like he planned and for helping a couple of "upstarts". The agent then gets a call and is told that by the orders of the [[Five Elders]], he is to kill [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] immediately. The agent reacts with outrage that he would be told to interfere with his fight with [[Kaidou]], but the agent on the other end tells him that it is a necessary precaution because of the nature of the battle. Unbeknownst to him, [[X Drake]] has woken up and tracked him down, determined not to go down empty handed.

Elsewhere in the basement, [[Usopp]] is rushing [[Kin'emon]] and [[Kikunojo]] to safety while [[Nekomamushi]], [[Wanda]], and [[Carrot]] head back inside the castle. [[Franky]] is also able to catch [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and keep him from falling off the island, though he is unsure if he is alive. And down in the [[Beasts Pirates|Beasts Pirates']] bath, [[Nami]] is hiding with [[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]] and her animals, who are being treated by [[Polo Marco|Marco]]. Nami deduces from the shockwave she felt that [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] had defeated [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]], which [[Zeus]] cries for before Nami reminds him of who his new master is. As for Law and [[Eustass Kid|Kid]]'s crews, they continue cheering for their captain's victory, but the two are too exhausted to fight Kaidou, leaving it all truly up to Luffy.

On the roof, after Luffy and Kaidou's clash, Kaidou deduces based on the shockwave that Big Mom had been beaten by Kid and Law, which Luffy praises the two of them for. He thinks back to the day he first met her on [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rock's]] crew, and after going into his '''Naki Jogo''' mode again, sobs uncontrollably over the fact that they just teamed up to get the One Piece together. Luffy, however, goes into '''Gear 4: Snakeman''', and uses '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques#Snakeman 2|Gomu Gomu no Hydra]]''' to strike Kaidou in multiple places. Luffy screams that his dreams starved the people of Wano, and with all the energy he has, he is going to make sure he will never come back to Wano.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Zunesha]] continues to walk to [[Wano Country]].
*[[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] continues to pull [[Onigashima]] away from the [[Flower Capital]].
**He reveals to [[Yamato]] that [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] tore out pages with crucial information from his [[Logbook#Kouzuki Oden's Logbook|logbook]] for an unknown reason. 
***Because of this, Momonosuke is afraid to open up Wano to the rest of the world due to the potential danger it may face.
*[[Raizo]] and [[Fukurokuju]] both collapse from the fire.
**Raizo is confirmed to be the winner of the battle.
**[[Jinbe]] meets up with Raizo, who is still conscious.
**Raizo mentions that there are preparations in course for an unknown purpose.
*On the second floor treasury, [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] gets angry as "[[Kouzuki Hiyori|Komurasaki]]" continues to play her shamisen with her mask on.
**The ceiling collapses over Orochi leaving him trapped, who cannot escape by [[Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: Yamata no Orochi|transforming]] as Komurasaki had used a nail made from [[Seastone]] that she had secretly planted on him when he was distracted upon seeing her earlier.
**When Komurasaki reveals that his favorite song [[Moon Princess]] was also the favorite song of her father Kouzuki Oden, it causes Orochi to realize her "true identity".
*The fight between [[Izou]] and [[CP0]] concludes.
**Izou manages to defeat [[Maha]], one of the agents, before collapsing at the same time.
**[[Guernika]] talks to [[Joseph]] via [[Den Den Mushi]].
***Guernika reveals the new orders he had received from the [[Five Elders]] is to eliminate [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] at once due to the potential danger he possesses if he succeeds at defeating [[Kaidou]].
**[[X Drake|Drake]] manages to recover from his defeat and stands up behind Guernika.
*[[Franky]] reaches [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and catches him in time before he falls off Onigashima.
*[[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]]'s group are with [[Polo Marco|Marco]], who treats [[Komachiyo]] and [[Hihimaru]].
*[[Eustass Kid|Kid]] and [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] are still lying down conscious after defeating [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]].
*The fight between Kaidou and Luffy continues.
**Kaidou senses that Big Mom has been defeated and recalls his first encounter with her.
***Kaidou is mentioned to have joined the [[Rocks Pirates]] at age 15. 
**Luffy transforms into his [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques#Snakeman|Snakeman form]] in a final attack and relentlessly attacks Kaidou, determined to keep going and defeat him before he runs out of strength.
